name: School Heaven ~Love Ero Harem ☆ Momoiro Typhoon~
original_name: すくーるヘブン　らぶえろハーレム☆ももいろタイフーン
source:
Main character is a student at a private school where his grandfather is the chairman. Grandfather wants him to inherit this school, but protagonist has no signs of interest. Then chairman gets several girls move in into protagonist's dormitory as bride candidates...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-january-2006-io.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是私立学校的学生，祖父则担任学校理事长。祖父希望他将来继承学校，主人公却毫无兴趣。于是，理事长安排几名女孩作为新娘候选人，搬进主人公的宿舍…
